many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def comps_of(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; res=[]
    for r_ in range(h):
        for c_ in range(w):
            if g[r_][c_]!=bg and not seen[r_][c_]:
                col=g[r_][c_]; st=[(r_,c_)]; cells=set(); seen[r_][c_]=True
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop(); cells.add((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and not seen[nx][ny] and g[nx][ny]==col:
                            seen[nx][ny]=True; st.append((nx,ny))
                res.append({'col':col,'cells':set(cells),'n':len(cells)})
    return res
import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for i in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    bgval=Counter(x for rr in gi for x in rr).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(gi,bgval); big=[p for p in cs if len(p['cells'])>1]; singles=[p for p in cs if len(p['cells'])==1]
    for s in sorted(singles,key=lambda p:(p['cells'][0])):
        r,c=list(s['cells'])[0]
        outv=go[r][c]
        info=[]
        for p in big:
            nch=sum(1 for x,y in p['cells'] if abs(x-r)<=1 and abs(y-c)<=1)
            ds=min(abs(r-x)+abs(c-y) for x,y in p['cells'])
            info.append((ds,nch,p['col'],p['n']))
        info.sort()
        ok=(outv!=bgval)
        # rule condition
        cond = any(nch>=4 for _,nch,_,_ in info)
        # tie-break check: which colors have >=4?
        multi=[(tc,tn) for _,_,tc,tn in info if tn>=4]
        pred2=outv!=bgval and (sum(1 for t in multi if t[1]>=4)==1 and True)
        bad=False
        print(f'D{i}',('keep' if ok else 'erase'), (r,c),'multi_color_count={}'.format(len(multi)),
              [(t[1],t[2],t[3]) for t in multi],'top=',info[0], 'match_rule_ok' if (ok== (len(multi)>=1)) else '')
